com.github.miachm.sods

Class ChartProperties

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.github.miachm.sods.ChartProperties

  • public class ChartProperties
extends Object
    Holds chart-specific properties. These options map to ODS chart settings and control aspects like axis positioning, label handling, symbol rendering, and layout behavior.

    • Method Detail

      • getDisplayLabel

        public Boolean getDisplayLabel()
        Returns whether labels are displayed. Labels are typically value labels or series labels that can be rendered directly on the chart.
        Returns:
        True if labels are displayed.

      • getLogarithmic

        public Boolean getLogarithmic()
        Returns whether logarithmic scaling is enabled. When enabled, the axis is scaled logarithmically instead of linearly.
        Returns:
        True if logarithmic scaling is enabled.

      • getReverseDirection

        public Boolean getReverseDirection()
        Returns whether the axis direction is reversed. Reversed axes display values in the opposite direction.
        Returns:
        True if the axis direction is reversed.

      • getLinkDataStyleToSource

        public Boolean getLinkDataStyleToSource()
        Returns whether data style is linked to the source. When enabled, the chart follows the data style defined in the sheet.
        Returns:
        True if linked to source.

      • getAutoPosition

        public Boolean getAutoPosition()
        Returns whether auto-positioning is enabled. Auto-positioning allows the document engine to place elements automatically within the chart area.
        Returns:
        True if auto-positioning is enabled.

      • getAutoSize

        public Boolean getAutoSize()
        Returns whether auto-sizing is enabled. Auto-size allows the document engine to size elements based on content.
        Returns:
        True if auto-sizing is enabled.

      • getRightAngledAxes

        public Boolean getRightAngledAxes()
        Returns whether right-angled axes are enabled. When enabled, axes are forced to render at right angles.
        Returns:
        True if right-angled axes are enabled.

      • getIncludeHiddenCells

        public Boolean getIncludeHiddenCells()
        Returns whether hidden cells are included. When enabled, hidden rows/columns can still contribute values to the chart.
        Returns:
        True if hidden cells are included.

      • getTextLineBreak

        public Boolean getTextLineBreak()
        Returns whether text line breaks are enabled. This affects how multi-line labels are rendered.
        Returns:
        True if text line breaks are enabled.

      • getTryStaggeringFirst

        public Boolean getTryStaggeringFirst()
        Returns whether to try staggering labels first. Staggering is used to reduce label overlap by alternating positions.
        Returns:
        True if staggering is preferred.

      • getSymbolType

        public String getSymbolType()
        Returns the symbol type. This describes the marker style used for points (for example, circle or square).
        Returns:
        The symbol type.

      • getSymbolName

        public String getSymbolName()
        Returns the symbol name. The name corresponds to an ODS symbol identifier.
        Returns:
        The symbol name.

      • getSymbolWidth

        public String getSymbolWidth()
        Returns the symbol width. This is a serialized size value (for example, "0.2cm").
        Returns:
        The symbol width.

      • getSymbolHeight

        public String getSymbolHeight()
        Returns the symbol height. This is a serialized size value (for example, "0.2cm").
        Returns:
        The symbol height.

      • getTreatEmptyCells

        public ChartProperties.TreatEmptyCells getTreatEmptyCells()
        Returns the empty-cell behavior. This determines whether empty cells are ignored, treated as zero, or rendered as gaps in the chart.
        Returns:
        The empty-cell behavior.

      • getAxisPosition

        public Integer getAxisPosition()
        Returns the axis position index. This value indicates where the axis intersects relative to the plot area.
        Returns:
        The axis position.
